rationale: The stock has sold off sharply intraday (from open ~$26.50 to ~$24.67), trading well below session VWAP ($26.72) and 5-min VWAP ($24.92), suggesting sustained selling pressure — but the last five 5-minute candles show an extremely tight consolidation with ATR of only $0.04, making it nearly impossible to define a risk/reward level with meaningful separation between stop and target.
